description: Source file implementing network interface utilities for Fuchsia platform, including conversion, verification, and retrieval of network interface properties.

classes.name: InterfaceProperties
classes.description: Represents properties of a network interface on Fuchsia, with methods for verification, updating, and appending network interface info.

methods.name: FuchsiaIpAddressToIPAddress
methods.description: Converts Fuchsia IP address to generic IPAddress.

methods.name: InterfaceProperties::VerifyAndCreate
methods.description: Verifies and creates an InterfaceProperties object from Fuchsia properties.

methods.name: InterfaceProperties::Update
methods.description: Updates interface properties with new Fuchsia properties.

methods.name: InterfaceProperties::AppendNetworkInterfaces
methods.description: Appends network interface info to a list.

methods.name: InterfaceProperties::IsPubliclyRoutable
methods.description: Checks if the interface is publicly routable.

methods.name: ConvertConnectionType
methods.description: Converts Fuchsia device class to network connection type.

methods.name: VerifyCompleteInterfaceProperties
methods.description: Verifies that Fuchsia interface properties are complete.

methods.name: GetNetworkList
methods.description: Retrieves list of online network interfaces.

methods.name: GetWifiSSID
methods.description: Stub function for retrieving Wi-Fi SSID (not implemented).
